reply_text:
Installed GBrain v0.60.757.0 from the pinned GitHub release and connected it to your existing Hermes profile over local MCP. Your identity and existing instructions are unchanged; setup added a GBrain memory rule. The brain uses local PGLite with keyword-only search. No GBrain API keys or paid providers were configured.

Verification passed: GBrain’s `remember` committed a synthetic `install-check` fact as #1. A separate CLI process and a fresh connection through Hermes’s MCP registration both recalled it by exact keyword. Hermes’s own hook check passed, although GBrain’s setup command still reported a hook warning. The fresh Hermes chat test timed out, so recall from a new chat remains unverified. The marker expires in 24 hours; to complete that check, start a new Hermes session, ask it to recall `install-check`, then ask it to forget fact #1.

Search mode: conservative is active because no chat key or reranker is configured. You can switch at any time with `~/.local/bin/gbrain config set search.mode <mode>`.

  Conservative — 4K-token cap, 10 chunks, no reranking.
  Balanced — 12K-token cap, 25 chunks, reranking if configured.
  Tokenmax — no token cap, 50 chunks, reranking if configured.

Estimated downstream input cost of the retrieved payload @ 10K queries/mo:

                  Haiku 5.5     Sonnet 5.5    Opus 5.5
                  ($0.10/M in)  ($2/M in)     ($4/M in)
  conservative    $4/mo         $80/mo        $160/mo
  balanced        $10/mo        $200/mo       $400/mo
  tokenmax        $20/mo        $400/mo       $800/mo

  Assumed payload per query: conservative 4K, balanced 10K, tokenmax 20K tokens.
  Scales linearly: x10 for 100K queries/mo, /10 for 1K. 200x corner-to-corner spread.
  Embedding, reranking and query expansion are separate provider charges.

These are published model-input estimates, not Hermes subscription prices. GBrain retrieval is local, but recalled text can enter the context sent to Hermes’s configured model.

Automatic fact capture is off. Free upkeep runs while GBrain is connected, and the local redacted conversation archive is on by default; turn it off with `~/.local/bin/gbrain transcripts archive off`. No scheduled jobs or optional workspace skills were added. Hosted GBrain at https://gbrain.io is an alternative; no hosted workspace was created.
